summary: Explainable large-file storage triage without LLM

delivery.outcome: Provide read-only, bounded large-file triage above500 decimal MB with deterministic explainable rules, grouped local reports, active-use evidence and truthful physical/logical accounting, without LLM or automatic deletion.
nonGoals: No host data deletion or process/service changes
No changes to cleanup execution, other owners, swap configuration or source publication policy
No claim that unknown dependencies are absent or that allocated bytes guarantee reclaim

architecture.decision: Separate a bounded filesystem/proc evidence collector and pure ordered decision rules; expose a lazy storage command and reuse the collector in the legacy DiskAnalyzer. Reports preserve uncertain coverage and do not authorize cleanup.
interfaceChanges: Add fixos storage with read-only table/JSON/CSV/HTML output using fixos.storage-triage/v1
architecture.rollback: Revert the feature commit through normal protected delivery; no data migration or cleanup needs reversal.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_large_file_triage.py tests/unit/test_storage_cmd.py tests/unit/test_disk_analyzer.py tests/unit/test_disk_analyzer_capacity.py
